editorial.blurb: The Evie strikes an elegant balance between sophisticated and approachable, delivering excellent American and Japanese fare in a beautifully designed space where attentive service and lively bar energy make every visit memorable.
editorial.insiderTip: Sit at the bar for the best energy and attentive service; order the steak frites or salmon with bok choy and pair with a well-crafted cocktail like an Old Fashioned.
signatureDishes: Salmon with rice and bok choy

topDishes.note: Juiciest and most delicious, absolutely essential to order
